I replaced all the stubs in `minidb/expr_eval.py` with working implementations. `tests/test_expr_eval.py` now passes (25 tests). I didn't run the rest of the suite, so the integration tests are unchecked.

I added one private helper, `_check_bool`, which raises `TypeMismatchError` for any operand that isn't a bool or None. I didn't change the test file.

I also made `compare` raise `TypeMismatchError` for an operator outside the six comparison ops. The docstring doesn't cover that case.
